secrets.name: IQ_EMAIL
secrets.description: IQ Option account email (login). Required for the bot to connect.

secrets.name: IQ_PASSWORD
secrets.description: IQ Option account password. Required alongside IQ_EMAIL.

secrets.name: IQ_PROXY
secrets.description: Optional proxy to reach IQ Option when the hosting network blocks it (e.g. http://host:port or socks5://host:port). Leave empty if IQ Option is directly reachable.
